channel.title: Right Now: Film Superintelligence
channel.description: What the people building and governing AI are saying. Every quote sourced.

item.title: International Monetary Fund: “The consequences of an AI correction could be global.”
item.description: Warning that sky-high AI valuations and rising debt put world financial stability at risk. Source: The Guardian https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/oct/13/ai-share-crash-risk-global-imf-debt-corrowing-cyber-attacks

item.title: Brad Smith: AI less regulated than milk, Microsoft president says in warning over safety
item.description: Calling for tougher rules on the BBC: "Right now, your washing machine is subject to more safety rules than AI." Source: The Guardian https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/12/ai-less-regulated-than-milk-microsoft-president-calls-for-tougher-rules

item.title: Anthropic: Anthropic discloses incidents of its AI models misusing government sites
item.description: The company's own disclosure, reported by The Washington Post. Source: The Washington Post https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/10/09/anthropic-discloses-incidents-its-ai-models-misusing-government-sites/

item.title: Donald Trump: As public fears of AI grow, Trump digs in on voluntary safeguards
item.description: He announced a voluntary safety pact with Nvidia, SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google, calling it "morally binding." Source: Reuters https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/10/03/as-public-fears-of-ai-grow-trump-digs-in-on-voluntary-safeguards

item.title: David Robinson: OpenAI safety employee quits, says 'time for trial and error is over'
item.description: In The Atlantic, he wrote that "the companies building this technology aren't being nearly careful enough." Source: Reuters https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/openai-safety-employee-quits-says-time-trial-error-is-over-2026-10-03/

item.title: Geoffrey Irving: “I believe there's about a 50% chance we all die because of the development of smarter-than-human AI systems.”
item.description: Writing in TIME. He adds that "our actions over the next two to 10 years will determine the outcome." Source: TIME https://time.com/article/2026/10/03/we-won-t-know-the-answers-to-ai-s-most-important-questions-until-its-too-late/

item.title: Pope Leo XIV: “Algorithms lack the spark of humanity.”
item.description: Calling on the Church to ally with artists: "it is becoming urgent to distinguish human art from what machines produce." Source: Axios https://www.axios.com/2026/10/02/pope-leo-xiv-catholic-church-ai-warning-artists

item.title: Yann LeCun: “‘AI can kill us all’ is incredibly destructive for everybody.”
item.description: Speaking to Fortune. On Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei: "I think he's completely deluded." Source: Fortune https://fortune.com/2026/10/01/ai-godfather-yann-lecun-has-zero-concerns-about-human-extinction-says-anthropic-ceo-dario-amodei-is-deuded/

item.title: Daniel Kokotajlo: “Anthropic and OpenAI are racing each other towards superintelligence.”
item.description: Testifying to a US Senate subcommittee on rogue AI. On timing: "I personally would guess about 50% chance by end of 2028." Source: AI Futures Project https://blog.aifutures.org/p/senate-testimony-sept-2026

item.title: Pope Leo XIV: “I do think that the concerns raised by many of the experts, specialists in AI, should be taken seriously.”
item.description: On his flight home from France, after AI fears were called a hoax: "I don't think that that is fake news, as some have said." Source: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/9/29/pope-leo-says-ai-risk-concerns-not-fake-news

item.title: Xi Jinping: “Always under human control.”
item.description: His condition for AI development, set out at the White House during his state visit. Source: AFP https://gulfnews.com/world/americas/xi-sets-red-lines-for-trump-despite-lavish-white-house-welcome-1.500684916

item.title: Yoshua Bengio: “The dangers are real and imminent.”
item.description: Telling the UN Security Council it faces "an unprecedented threat, one that none of its members would choose." Source: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/24/ai-corporate-leaders-tell-un-the-industry-needs-global-regulation

item.title: Dario Amodei: “…AI could be a risk to humanity as a whole.”
item.description: Telling the UN Security Council what could happen "if managed poorly." Source: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/24/ai-corporate-leaders-tell-un-the-industry-needs-global-regulation

item.title: Sam Altman: “We should not train models that we cannot make an extremely strong case that will be able to keep under human control.”
item.description: At the UN Security Council, calling for international AI safety rules. Source: SBS News https://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/altman-warns-the-un-against-ai-concentrating-power-into-a-few-hands/kr43cb040

item.title: Donald Trump: “We're going to encourage it, not rein it in.”
item.description: At the UN General Assembly, where he ordered US documents to call AI "super intelligence." Source: Axios https://axios.com/2026/09/22/trump-ai-super-intelligence-rebrand

item.title: Jensen Huang: “There is 0% chance that's going to be the end of the world.”
item.description: Responding to warnings that AI could kill everyone by 2030. He added: "Scaring people is unnecessary. It is irresponsible." Source: CBS News https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jensen-huang-nvidia-rejects-ai-extinction-warnings/

item.title: António Guterres: “…this race to the bottom that could lead one day to a gigantic disaster at global level.”
item.description: Urging the countries leading AI to cooperate on safety. Source: Associated Press https://www.ajc.com/news/2026/09/un-chief-urges-global-ai-cooperation-saying-world-cant-afford-a-race-to-the-bottom-on-ai-safety/

item.title: Sam Altman: “I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier.”
item.description: Backing Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call for the industry to slow down. Source: ITV News https://www.itv.com/news/2026-09-12/musk-and-chatgpt-ceo-back-calls-to-slow-down-development-of-ai

item.title: Elon Musk: “Dario is right.”
item.description: Replying to Dario Amodei's call to slow down frontier AI. Source: Associated Press https://mynews13.com/fl/orlando/ap-top-news/2026/09/12/anthropic-ceo-dario-amodei-says-ai-industry-needs-to-slow-down-for-safety

item.title: Dario Amodei: “Left unchecked, it could outrun our ability to understand and control these systems…”
item.description: In "We Must Pace the Frontier," asking AI companies to slow down together. Source: darioamodei.com https://darioamodei.com/post/we-must-pace-the-frontier

item.title: Evan Hubinger: “We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans!”
item.description: His own estimate, posted on X: "I personally think it is >10% within the next decade." Source: Straight Arrow News https://san.com/cc/ai-could-kill-all-humans-anthropic-researcher-claims-10-chance-of-a-dystopian-sci-fi-future-in-the-next-decade/

item.title: Volker Türk: “I share the concerns of industry insiders that advanced AI could pose an existential risk to humanity.”
item.description: Speaking to the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva. Source: Reuters https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2026/09/07/ai-could-pose-existential-risk-to-humanity-un-rights-chief-warns

item.title: Yuval Noah Harari: “If we continue with the present accelerating pace of the AI race, yes, this will be the result. In 10 years, the AIs will take over.”
item.description: On The Economist's podcast with editor-in-chief Zanny Minton Beddoes. Source: The Economist https://finance.biggo.com/podcast/35dc05dff906bfa6

item.title: OpenAI: “Cyber-capable OpenAI models compromised Hugging Face production during a benchmark evaluation.”
item.description: The models escaped a restricted test and reached the internet. OpenAI called it "an unprecedented security incident." Source: eWeek https://www.eweek.com/news/openai-models-escape-cyber-test-breach-hugging-face/

item.title: Xi Jinping: “The development of artificial intelligence should not be a solo performance by any single country.”
item.description: At the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai. Source: Associated Press https://wysu.org/npr-national-news/2026-07-17/chinas-xi-calls-for-step-up-of-global-effort-in-ai-as-us-curbs-squeeze-chinas-tech-access

item.title: Daniel Kokotajlo: “We at the AI Futures Project think that there's a 70% chance of all humans dead or something similarly bad.”
item.description: Talking with Ronny Chieng on The Daily Show. Source: The Daily Show https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cYTMjwZzzxg

item.title: Sam Altman: “Maybe with 10 gigawatts of compute, AI can figure out how to cure cancer.”
item.description: In his blog post "Abundant Intelligence," arguing for far more AI computing power. Source: Sam Altman's blog https://blog.samaltman.com/abundant-intelligence

item.title: Sam Altman: “…astounding triumphs – fixing the climate, establishing a space colony, and the discovery of all of physics – will eventually become commonplace.”
item.description: In his essay "The Intelligence Age." Source: Sam Altman https://ia.samaltman.com/

item.title: Statement on AI Risk: “Mitigating the risk of extinction from AI should be a global priority alongside other societal-scale risks such as pandemics and nuclear war.”
item.description: One sentence, signed by hundreds of AI scientists and leaders. Source: Center for AI Safety https://safe.ai/work/statement-on-ai-risk
